children: The Czech central bank's board will be deciding between rate stability and an increase to address inflationary risks mainly from the domestic economy when it next meets on policy in November, Governor Ales Michl said on Thursday.
The board unanimously left the main repo rate unchanged at 3.75% earlier on Thursday, following a hike in June and no change in August.
